tasks.title: Setup Plugin Project Structure
tasks.description: Initialize the Minecraft plugin project with proper structure and configuration for Spigot/Paper server compatibility.
tasks.details:
Create a Maven/Gradle project with the following structure:
- Use Gradle 8.4+ for build management
- Target Java 17 compatibility (required for Minecraft 1.19+)
- Include Paper-API 1.19.4-R0.1-SNAPSHOT as dependency
- Create plugin.yml with proper metadata
- Setup config.yml for API keys and settings
- Implement main plugin class with onEnable/onDisable methods
- Create packages for modules: ai, voice, entity, commands, events, config
- Setup logging framework (SLF4J with Log4j2)
- Implement configuration manager for handling plugin settings

Dependencies to include:
- paper-api:1.19.4-R0.1-SNAPSHOT
- gson:2.10.1 (for JSON processing)
- slf4j-api:2.0.9
- log4j-core:2.20.0
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify plugin loads successfully on Paper 1.19.4 server
2. Test configuration loading/saving
3. Validate plugin.yml format
4. Check proper initialization and shutdown sequences
5. Verify compatibility with Java 17

tasks.title: Implement AI Entity Creation System
tasks.description: Develop a system to spawn and manage AI companion entities in the Minecraft world.
tasks.details:
Create classes for AI entity management:
- Implement EntityManager class to handle AI entity lifecycle
- Use Bukkit/Spigot API to create custom entities (NPC type)
- Utilize Citizens API 2.0.32+ for advanced NPC functionality if needed
- Create spawn/despawn methods with proper cleanup
- Implement entity persistence across server restarts
- Add entity tracking system to maintain entity-player relationships
- Support multiple AI entities for different players
- Implement basic pathfinding using Minecraft's built-in NavigationSystem
- Add methods for entity teleportation when stuck or too far from player
- Create entity attribute system (health, tools, inventory)

Key methods:
- spawnCompanion(Player owner, Location location)
- despawnCompanion(UUID companionId)
- getCompanionByOwner(Player owner)
- teleportToOwner(UUID companionId)
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test entity spawning in different biomes and environments
2. Verify entity persistence after server restart
3. Test entity-player relationship maintenance
4. Validate cleanup on plugin disable
5. Measure performance impact of multiple entities

tasks.title: Develop Basic Movement and Behavior System

Behavior implementations:
- FollowOwnerGoal extends PathfinderGoal
- GatherResourceGoal extends PathfinderGoal
- CombatGoal extends PathfinderGoal

Use NMS (Net Minecraft Server) or reflection if necessary for advanced pathfinding, but prefer Bukkit API when possible.

1. Test navigation in complex terrain (mountains, caves, water)
2. Verify proper following behavior at different distances
3. Test behavior switching based on context
4. Validate stuck detection and recovery
5. Measure pathfinding performance in complex environments
